comment_regular: Verified XOWN mutator: update ExtraOwnership.ownerForm when owner is nonnull; remove the XOWN extra when null; otherwise allocate a 16-byte ExtraOwnership payload and add it to the list. During plugin load the initial dword is a FormID temporarily held in the same union slot; ExtraDataList_ResolveLoadedFormIDs converts it to TESForm*. TESObjectCELL_LinkForm removes direct XOWN, XRNK, and XGLB from an exterior cell when an owner exists.
